title: Learning Defensive Policies against Diverse Inference Attacks for Smart Meter Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2609.25484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart meter (SM) data provides fine-grained visibility into household energy consumption, but also exposes users to privacy risks. Inference attacks, known as non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), can perform appliance-level inference from aggregate signals and recover sensitive behavioral patterns. In practice, attacker models are unknown and heterogeneous, making robust defense challenging. We formulate SM privacy protection as a black-box inference defense problem, aiming to reduce the recoverability of appliance-level information while generalizing across diverse and unseen attackers. We propose a proxy-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns battery-based load-shaping policies to inject realistic but misleading appliance-level signatures into the aggregate signal, thereby disrupting the structured patterns exploited by NILM. translated_title: 针对多样化推断攻击的智能电表隐私防御策略学习
translated_abstract: 智能电表（SM）数据提供了对家庭能源消耗的细粒度可见性，但同时也使用户面临隐私风险。被称为非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）的推断攻击可以从聚合信号中进行电器级别的推断，并恢复敏感的行为模式。在实践中，攻击者模型是未知且异构的，这使得鲁棒防御极具挑战性。我们将智能电表隐私保护形式化为一个黑盒推断防御问题，旨在降低电器级别信息的可恢复性，同时能够泛化到多样化和未见过的攻击者。我们提出了一种代理引导的分层强化学习框架，该框架学习基于电池的负荷整形策略，向聚合信号中注入真实但具有误导性的电器级别特征，从而破坏NILM所利用的结构化模式。一种自监督的聚合结构隐私探针提供了重建误差……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种代理引导的分层强化学习框架，通过学习基于电池的负荷整形策略向聚合信号注入真实但误导性的电器特征，从而防御多样化且未知的NILM推断攻击，保护智能电表用户隐私。
en_tdlr: A proxy-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning framework learns battery-based load-shaping policies that inject realistic yet misleading appliance-level signatures into aggregate smart meter signals, providing robust privacy defense against diverse and unseen NILM inference attacks.
